description: A production engineering standard for Bun and TypeScript applications, with a Bun CLI for architecture, security, permissions, database and deployment audits.
rules: Follow the documented feature-oriented architecture and keep domain logic independent of frameworks and infrastructure.
Validate external input at runtime and use explicit DTOs at API boundaries.
Every API endpoint must be explicitly declared protected or intentionally public; missing policy information must never imply public access.
Authorization must be enforced server-side and must fail closed when identity, policy or evaluation is unavailable.
Treat static audit results as evidence, not proof; inspect runtime behavior and add authorization tests.
